stories.title: "Softhearted Gunner": an AI kitten can't shoot the zombie cat it loves
stories.summary: An AI-generated clip shows a teary orange kitten aiming a pistol at a zombified white cat, unable to pull the trigger, letting it lunge, then cutting to the two cuddling in a sunlit meadow. A Turkish X post captioned "Ağlıyorum" ("I'm crying") passed 2.4 million views within days and reached Korean and Turkish forums inside 48 hours, and remakes with other characters followed under the name "Softhearted Gunner."
